Living Room Furniture FAQ
Your living room is probably where your family spends most of their time at home, so getting the furniture right makes a huge difference in comfort and style. From figuring out what size sofa to buy to arranging everything so it actually works, we've covered the questions people ask most about creating a living room that fits their lifestyle.

How to arrange living room furniture?
Start by placing your largest piece, usually the sofa, against the longest wall or facing the room's focal point like a fireplace or TV. Arrange other seating pieces like accent chairs to create a conversation area with about 8 feet between facing furniture for comfortable interaction in your home. Ashley offers living room sets designed to work together, making furniture arrangement easier with coordinated pieces that fit well in most room layouts.

Where to buy living room furniture?
Ashley offers a wide range of living room furniture both in their retail stores and online with convenient delivery and setup services for your home. You can browse their collection of leather sofas, sectionals, accent chairs, coffee tables, and entertainment centers that coordinate together for a cohesive living room design that fits your style and budget.

How to arrange living room furniture with tv?
Position your sofa directly facing the TV at a comfortable viewing distance, typically 8-12 feet away depending on your screen size. Arrange additional seating like chairs or a loveseat at angles that still provide good TV viewing while creating conversation areas, and consider how your decor elements will complement the TV setup. Ashley offers living room sets designed with TV viewing in mind, including sectionals and recliners positioned for optimal entertainment comfort.

How to arrange living room furniture in small space?
Position your furniture away from walls to create the illusion of more space and define different areas within your living room. Choose a leather loveseat, compact chair, or apartment-sized sofa instead of a full sectional to maintain proportion and leave room for movement. Ashley designs small space furniture pieces that provide comfort without overwhelming small living spaces.

How to pick living room furniture?
Choose a focal point like your sofa first, then build around it with complementary pieces that serve your daily activities. Think about how you use your living room - for watching TV, reading, or socializing - and select furniture that supports those functions, whether you prefer traditional comfort or modern streamlined designs. Ashley designs coordinated collections that take the guesswork out of mixing and matching pieces.

How to mix match living room furniture?
Choose one dominant style and add accent pieces from other styles to create interest without overwhelming your space with too many competing elements. For example, pair a traditional sofa with a modern coffee table, add an accent chair in a contrasting style, or incorporate a reclining chair with industrial lighting to farmhouse furniture. Ashley designs their collections to complement each other, making it simple to mix pieces and decor from different lines successfully.

When is the best time to buy living room furniture?
The best times to buy living room furniture are typically during major sale events like Black Friday, end-of-year clearances, and back-to-school promotions when retailers offer significant discounts. Spring is also good timing as stores clear inventory to make room for new collections coming in summer. Ashley runs seasonal deals and promotional events throughout the year with special financing options.
